fields.name: product_form
fields.rationale: The product is available in plank and 3-strip variants, which are common forms for parquet flooring.
evidence: Scope: This EPD applies for one square metre of Longlife parquet in the plank and 3-strip variants

fields.name: surface_finish
fields.rationale: The parquet products feature an oiled or varnished surface, which affects the appearance and maintenance of the flooring.
evidence: The products feature an oiled or varnished surface ready for residential use

fields.name: installation_method
fields.rationale: The parquet can be installed as a floating installation or glued to the screed, which are common methods for wood flooring.
evidence: The floor coverings are laid on screeds, tiles or wooden substructures in conjunction with suitable laying underlays (insulation underlays) as a floating installation or glued to the screed over the entire surface.
inference_basis: floating installation and glued installation are standard methods for parquet flooring
